action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Pull
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git stash drop && git pull origin main 2>&1 | tail -5")
print("Pull:", stdout.read().decode())

# Fix tsconfig
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && sed -i 's/\"module\": \"ESNext\"/\"module\": \"NodeNext\"/' server/tsconfig.json")

# Add type module
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('cd /opt/areloria && sed -i "/private.*true/a\\  \\"type\\": \\"module\\"," package.json')

# Build
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && pnpm --filter @wasd/server build 2>&1 | tail -10")
print("\nBuild:", stdout.read().decode())

# Run
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && timeout 10 node server/dist/index.js 2>&1 || true")
print("\n=== Run ===")
print(stdout.read().decode()[:500])

client.close()
EOF
